intent: Lock scope, acceptance, and reviewer paths before infrastructure work.
determinism_rules: LF-only line endings for text-like files
byte-for-byte goldens checked by the proof gate
expected-fail fixtures are first-class receipts (single error.txt)
acceptance_boundaries: Each chapter milestone is one PR that adds exactly that chapter’s fixture(s).
No placeholder case names in manuscript or fixtures.
A reviewer can verify the delta by inspecting names-only paths and running make verify.
The fixture ladder produces deterministic receipts (kit_index.json + manifest.sha256).
non_goals: No cloud credentials or secrets inside fixtures (no secrets rule).
No implicit behavior: contracts must be explicit and reviewable.
